patterns.note: A full-bleed dark background is used consistently across all sections, with content centered and constrained to a maximum width.
Horizontal scrollable sections are used to showcase multiple examples or categories, allowing users to browse a wide range of content without vertical clutter.
Major section headings are rendered in a large, bold, uppercase display font, creating a strong visual hierarchy against the dark background.
A high-contrast dark theme is dominant, featuring white text on black or very dark grey backgrounds, with a warm orange/gold used for primary call-to-action buttons.
The primary navigation bar transforms on scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a solid black background as it becomes sticky at the top of the viewport.
Content sections and individual elements within them are revealed with subtle fade-in or slide-up animations as the user scrolls them into view.
Feature and testimonial sections utilize a grid layout with cards that maintain a consistent dark aesthetic, often featuring subtle borders or background variations.

technique_notes: A sticky navigation bar dynamically changes its height and background color from transparent to solid black upon scrolling past the initial hero section, providing a persistent yet adaptive header.

Sections are revealed as the user scrolls into view, with elements within the sections appearing with a staggered fade-in or slide-up animation, likely using scroll-triggered animations (e.g., Intersection Observer with CSS keyframes or a JavaScript library like GSAP ScrollTrigger).

The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with high contrast text and subtle interactive elements, creating a modern, tech-focused feel. Interactive elements like the horizontal project showcase are implemented with smooth scrolling and potentially embedded canvas or video content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, uppercase display headings (~3-4x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller, often uppercase labels for sub-sections.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and input fields, with sharp edges maintained for larger content blocks and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a more balanced density within feature grids and the footer.

standout: The site's distinctive dark, high-contrast aesthetic combined with dynamic, interactive content presentation, particularly the horizontal scrolling project showcase and the prominent use of a real-time interactive engine, sets it apart. The seamless integration of a powerful design tool's capabilities into the marketing site itself is a key differentiator.
